verdict.rationale: Mercury states first-party sync with QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite, plus AI-powered automations for closing the books. Receipts are auto-attached to card transactions, and its OAuth program explicitly covers accounting tools integrating with Mercury, which together support automatic syncing of transactions and expenses. The sync claim, however, rests on a single marketing line. Missing for 10: documentation of sync mechanics (frequency, field/category mapping, reconciliation behavior), explicit confirmation that expense and reimbursement data sync alongside transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
